# Dash UI Callbacks

*Navigation: [[index|← StashStats Index]] / [[web-app|Web Application]] / Dash UI Callbacks*
*Siblings: [[web-components|Reusable UI Components]]*

Dash callbacks handle asynchronous user interactions, filtering, search triggers, and account toggling.

## Stash Filtering & Pagination Callback

`update_stash_view_logic` processes search inputs, sort criteria, and page changes to re-render the accordion view:

```{.python include="../src/stashstats/web/callbacks/stash.py" snippet="stash-callback-logic"}
```

## Callback Modules

- **`web.callbacks.stash`**: Stash search, sorting, and manual yarn additions. See [[client-stash|Stash Client Operations]].
- **`web.callbacks.analytics`**: Chart dimension toggles and timeframe filtering. See [[analytics-overview|Analytics Engine Overview]].
- **`web.callbacks.auth`**: Real-time account switching (`dev` ↔ `prod`) and credential validation modal. See [[auth|Authentication & Accounts]].
- **`web.callbacks.projects`**: Project status updates and photo previews. See [[client-projects|Project Client Operations]].
